<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The meeting has been successfully booked by Alison for Monday at 11:00 AM. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. The required parameters are `day`, `start`, and `body`.

*   `day`: 'Mon'
*   `start`: '11:00'
*   `body`: I will write a professional email confirming the meeting details.

After sending the email, the task will be complete, and I can end my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"body":"Dear Partners,

This email confirms the booking of your upcoming meeting.

The meeting is scheduled for Monday, November 16, at 11:00 AM Eastern.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Brad and Alison
Scheduling Assistants
Hale & Raman LLP","start":"11:00","day":"Mon"}
